📸 FARMER TESTIMONIAL IMAGES REQUIRED
=====================================

Please add 3 farmer images to this folder with these EXACT names:

1. farmer1-ramesh.jpg     → Ramesh Patil (man with grapes, pink/red shirt)
2. farmer2-bhausaheb.jpg  → Bhausaheb Shinde (man in white with vegetables)
3. farmer3-sunita.jpg     → Sunita Deshmukh (woman in vineyard, orange basket)

These images will appear in the "Voices from the Field" testimonials section on the homepage.

IMPORTANT:
- File names must match EXACTLY as shown above
- Supported formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png
- Recommended size: 400x400px or larger (square/portrait)
- Keep file size under 500KB for fast loading

After adding the images:
1. Save the files in this folder
2. Restart the frontend dev server: cd frontend && npm run dev
3. Clear browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+R)
4. Check homepage testimonials section
